curation_rule: Queue generation records no biological decisions. Promote only rows with adjudication_decision=accepted and nonblank final_value.
final_value_policy: Accepted rows require final_value/reviewer provenance. When trait_name is in the ontology or is a declared proxy trait, final_value must match that controlled vocabulary.

input_policy.visual: Image rows are visible-trait candidates only; no reproductive or pollinator state is inferred from images.
input_policy.reported_ecology: LLM rows must preserve source excerpts and remain review candidates until accepted by a reviewer.
